title: spec(type-compat): lift the oracle RAW(16) → lookup / master_detail pairing from lossy once the driver binds uuid through HEXTORAW
body:
domain:server#4 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmP8JJo4zF2sjTBRwnX

carries item 3 of #31390; #31390 keeps items 1, 2 and 4 (the driver-sql oracle bind, the malformed-uuid refusal, the live pins).

Filing gate: a self-split of a queued `domain:server` card (`execution-duties.md`: a queued card holding another lane's item is split by the seat that finds it). Item 3 edits `packages/spec/src/data/type-compat.ts`, and the server lane makes no `packages/spec` edit beyond prose. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage routes it (expected `domain:spec`).
Ruling-ref: ADR-0015 §4.6 (as cited on #31390)
Blocked-by: #31390
Dedupe (open AND closed): "HEXTORAW", "RAW(16) lossy oracle lookup" → #31390 only.

## 维护者速读

Oracle 的 `RAW(16)`(`SYS_GUID()`)主键现在在类型兼容表里对 `lookup` / `master_detail` 标为 `lossy`,因为驱动还不能按 uuid 字符串过滤或写入它。#31390 补上驱动绑定后，这里把这一对从 `lossy` 改为兼容，并更新对应 pin 与 `demoteExact` 注释。放宽接受面，需要契约复审。

## Task

- [ ] `packages/spec/src/data/type-compat.ts`: drop the oracle / `uuid` `demoteExact` rule (or narrow it) so `RAW(16)` → `lookup` / `master_detail` answers compatible again, and rewrite the JSDoc that says "Binding through `HEXTORAW` is #31390".
- [ ] Update the pin(s) that hold today's `'lossy'` answer.
- [ ] Only after #31390's bind has landed on `main`: the pairing must not be declared before the runtime honours it.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` expected · `Metadata-protocol:` to be measured (a federation draft that carried a `// REVIEW:` marker no longer does).
